# Subway Seat for Alfred

A walnut window with a recessed search field; the selected result sits on a soft orange tint with its hotkey in orange.

[Alfred](https://www.alfredapp.com) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/alfred/) · Needs Alfred 5 with the Powerpack

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`Subway Seat.alfredappearance`](Subway%20Seat.alfredappearance) | double-click it to import into Alfred |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`Subway Seat Tunnel.alfredappearance`](Subway%20Seat%20Tunnel.alfredappearance) | double-click it to import into Alfred |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`Subway Seat Enamel.alfredappearance`](Subway%20Seat%20Enamel.alfredappearance) | double-click it to import into Alfred |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Alfred Preferences › Appearance:

```text
Double-click Subway Seat.alfredappearance, then pick Subway Seat under Appearance
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Alfred Preferences › Appearance:

```text
Double-click Subway Seat Tunnel.alfredappearance, then pick Subway Seat Tunnel under Appearance
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Alfred Preferences › Appearance:

```text
Double-click Subway Seat Enamel.alfredappearance, then pick Subway Seat Enamel under Appearance
```

## Follow light and dark

In Alfred Preferences › Appearance:

```text
Alfred keeps one theme for macOS Light mode and one for Dark mode:
with macOS in Light mode, pick Subway Seat Enamel;
switch macOS to Dark mode, then pick Subway Seat (or Subway Seat Tunnel).
```
